$comment: Hand-curated additions merged over grammar.generated.json by scripts/extract-grammar.mjs. Per entry: `add` (evidence string) creates an entry the source scan cannot see; any other field is merged into the generated entry. Only record what a source or doc actually says — cite it.

normalSizeScale.add: create-ixmap API_REFERENCE.md:116 (schema v1.2 has it under map.scaleParam; flat reads .options() keys indirectly)

glExtensions.$comment: Keys ixmaps-gl reads that ixmaps-flat does not know. Valid with --engine gl; flagged as gl-only with --engine flat (flat ignores them silently).

optionsKeys.splash: ixmaps-gl: false disables the loading splash
optionsKeys.validate: ixmaps-gl: opt-in grammar validation (true, or a validator module URL)
optionsKeys.trustedscripts: ixmaps-gl: URL prefixes under which a project's data.ext scripts (processing scripts, brokers) may run (off by default; ignored when set by a project file)
optionsKeys.datajs: ixmaps-gl: data.js build to load (url), or false for none — loaded by default from flat's CDN URL
optionsKeys.worldcopies: ixmaps-gl: false draws the world once (default true: MapLibre world copies, themes repeated on each; false also limits the zoom-out to the window width)

dataKeys.remap: ixmaps-gl: per-field value remapping at load

mapInstanceMethods.getValidationReport: ixmaps-gl: findings of the opt-in grammar validation (null when off)
mapInstanceMethods.setLegend: ixmaps-gl runtime switch for the legend map option (same values as ixmaps.Map(id, {legend}): on, "closed", off)

glInternal.$comment: gl-only reads that are NOT grammar: extractor noise (MapLibre style objects / DOM nodes named `style`) or engine internals. Excluded from checks.

gl.note: ixmaps-gl runs a data.ext script only when its URL is under the page's .options({trustedscripts}): a processing script on a loaded csv file (ixmaps.<name>.after/.process) or a broker (type "ext")
ixmaps-gl reads data.name only to find a script's functions (ixmaps.<name>.after/.process, or the broker ixmaps.<name>) and to match setExternalData; not a table/cache name

ixmaps-gl ports flat's per-item form (loadValuesOfTheme: one value field with field100 → v − field100; several value fields → neighbour differences, last dropped) and after aggregation (maptheme.js 11000-11101): field100 on the cell sums for value-based AGGREGATE themes, and the series difference over a cell's values (grid PLOT)

flat's default (fNegativeValuePossible = true, maptheme.js 7742): the flag changes nothing there; ixmaps-gl likewise keeps negative values and sizes bubbles by the absolute value, as flat (valueRadius)

ixmaps-gl draws flat's chart box (maptheme.js 18446-18481, 18756-18925), matched against flat's SVG: a rectangle around the chart and its title (boxcolor, boxopacity, bordercolor, borderstyle, borderwidth, borderradius, boxmargin), or with CIRCULAR (CIRCULARBOX) a circle; shown between boxlower and boxupper. Tested as a substring, as flat. Not the AUTOSIZE/GRIDSIZE square box

ixmaps-gl draws the item title (binding title / titlefield) with a BOX, as flat's BOX block: font 5·normalX(1)·textscale in textcolor over a white halo, wrapped to the box width, a cell of more than 3 items titled "(n)". Tested as a substring, so BOTTOMTITLESUM counts; CLIPPEDTITLE and titleupper/titlelower are not read
ixmaps-gl puts the BOX title below the box (first baseline one font under it), as flat
stacked charts are not drawn by ixmaps-gl; it reads STACKED only to keep a per-item PLOT point marker for a 0 value, as flat does
ixmaps-gl always sizes CHART|BUBBLE by value (valueRadius) and never tests the SIZE flag (ixmaps-gl.js:3208) — behavior WITHOUT SIZE may differ from flat; unverified
ixmaps-gl aggregates as a per-record COUNT whenever binding.size is unset (ixmaps-gl.js:3802) and never tests the COUNT flag itself

ixmaps-gl runs a broker (ixmaps.<name>(theme, options) → setExternalData) from a data.ext script under the page's .options({trustedscripts}), or a page-defined ixmaps.<name>; the flat theme properties it sets (szFields, szSnippet, …) are applied to the theme definition
ixmaps-gl reads inline .data({obj}) as a row table itself, and a url through data.js (loaded by default, as flat)
